Vers une industrie intégrée de véhicules: Towards an integrated passenger vehicle industry
La société Tirsam, spécialisée dans la f: Tirsam, a company specializing in the manufacturing of vehicles as well as industrial and agricultural equipment, is studying the possibility of expanding its existing project or launching a new independent initiative dedicated to passenger vehicles. Based in Batna, the company is holding discussions with global automakers to forge a strategic partnership aimed at developing an integrated sector. During this meeting with the Minister of Industry, Farid Kourtel, emphasis was placed on the need to increase the local integration rate and consolidate the national subcontracting network in order to support the national economy and curb imports.
Ce développement fait suite à plusieurs: This development follows several milestones reached by the group, notably a visit by a delegation from the Japanese manufacturer Toyota on October 7, led in the presence of Tirsam CEO Samir Maala. This visit allowed the Japanese representatives to inspect the company's industrial facilities. Last August, Tirsam also hosted a delegation from its Chinese partner Sinotruk, led by its CEO Liu Zhengtao, marking the rollout of the three thousandth heavy truck from the Batna plant and the inauguration of a new welding line. Alongside these heavy-duty activities, Tirsam has opened orders for three bus models intended for the renewal of the public transport fleet.
